findings.title: Native semantic budgets run after initial frame allocation
findings.witness: input_digest recursively builds Frame with container capacities before reading semantic budgets; arena pushes all array children before later node-budget refusal
findings.prerequisites: Future owner routes sufficiently large nested/flat input into validation profile
findings.strongest_counterevidence: Private scaffold; final arena refusal is real; outer native framing and Serde limits must remain separately qualified
findings.required_fix_acceptance: Specify and enforce byte/depth/count/work bounds before costly construction at actual admitted native host; preserve existing first-error/order/owner behavior; no new thresholds selected. Do not add another generic validation facade.

findings.title: CSV row ceiling is not parser allocation ceiling
findings.witness: 1000-row guard runs after synchronous library constructs every record; no max_record_size is selected
findings.prerequisites: Actual CSV caller admits a large enough body or local direct string; upstream pinned source supports unlimited default record size
findings.strongest_counterevidence: Interfaces own1MiB transport guard and safe parse errors are real; deliberate parse-before-row-limit is accepted compatibility
findings.required_fix_acceptance: Qualify actual maximum bytes/columns/records/field work and peak-memory refusal. Keep agreed malformed-input precedence; any new thresholds need finite contract. Upstream option alone is not complete caller acceptance.

findings.title: CSV URL props need explicit trusted-route or sink policy
findings.witness: renewal href and commitPath emitted with HTML escaping but no unsafe-scheme/same-origin policy
findings.prerequisites: Adversary controls these props via a future/actual producer; no such tainted producer demonstrated in this audit
findings.strongest_counterevidence: Other renderers use safeHref; props may be trusted server route declarations; attribute escaping prevents markup injection
findings.required_fix_acceptance: Prove route-prop origin in actual rendering consumer; if user-derived, enforce appropriate URL admission at owning sink. Qualify javascript href and external form destination without imposing same-origin on ordinary links.
